expert.strategyHint: Who takes the task first, when to run serial or parallel, how results return and failures are handled.
expert.defaultStrategy1: The Leader first clarifies the goal, scope, acceptance criteria, and how failures are handled.
expert.defaultStrategy2: Members without prerequisites run in parallel; dependent tasks run serially in order.
expert.defaultStrategy3: Each member reports results, evidence, and blockers to the Leader, who coordinates.
expert.defaultStrategy4: Key decisions and the final delivery require human confirmation; on rejection, return to the relevant step to fix.
